research: Line: slate Florida -9.5; archive close Florida -8.5 (open 9.5). The Covers writer notes FSU +9.5 had moved to +8.5 by game day, so the close is a point better for Florida than the slate. Slightly favors FSU +9.5 on the slate number (slate archive; Covers, Nov 10).

[angle] This is Florida's first true road game of the season, at the Tucker Center, after a neutral-site win over Miami in Tampa and a home rout of Jacksonville 88-57. Florida's beat writer Chris Harry warned the trip would be a test. Helps FSU (Predictem, Nov 10).

[angle] FSU's size: four starters 6-7 or taller per KenPom, including 7-0, 285-lb Marcis Ponder (double-doubles in both games, 21 rebounds in the exhibition vs Auburn) and 6-11 Colorado transfer Sebastian Rancik (21.5 ppg). That blunts Florida's usual rebounding edge. Helps FSU (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).

FSU beat Troy going 34-of-39 at the line and winning the boards 46-21, and averages 102 points. But its opponents were Florida A&M (KenPom 343rd) and Troy (200th), so the numbers are inflated. Mixed (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).
FSU shoots 28.8% from three through two games. That helps Florida if FSU falls behind and needs threes (Predictem, Nov 10).
Florida: No. 1, KenPom 2nd, 6th in adjusted defense. It has made 11 threes in each game and is 28th in 3P% after ranking 321st last season. Helps Florida (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).
Florida is 297th in FT% over two games, so it may struggle to close out a lead. Helps FSU (Covers, Nov 10).
Florida's frontcourt of Rueben Chinyelu (career-high 21 vs Jacksonville), Alex Condon (12-12-8 line) and Thomas Haugh is the matchup with FSU's bigs. Helps Florida (Predictem, Nov 10).

Bart Torvik (still weighted to preseason) projects Florida by about 5 (82-77). The writers project Florida 81-74. Both are inside the number but already priced. Slight lean to FSU (Predictem, Nov 10).

[angle] Last season FSU covered as a 17.5-point road underdog, losing 78-76 in Gainesville, and forced 18 Florida turnovers. FSU went 4-2 ATS vs ranked teams last season. Head-to-head history only, so it is a tiebreaker for FSU at most (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).
Both preview writers (Covers' Geoff Clark and Predictem) took FSU +9.5. Preview picks are priced; I note them but don't count them (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).
games.reasoning: Florida's ratings edge is real, and the market moved toward FSU only by a point, to 8.5. Torvik's ~5-point projection leans FSU, but early-season ratings are priced and LESSONS says to pass early NCAAB. The most interesting angle is FSU's size against Florida's frontcourt on Florida's first road trip. A clear injury or rotation edge would have made it a pick.

research: Neutral site: Champions Classic at the United Center, Chicago. Duke is the designated home team (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).
Line: slate Duke -7.5; archive open -6.5, close -7.5. Predictem had 6.5 'at most books' in the morning, so the move was toward Duke. Treat -7.5 as fair (slate archive; Predictem, Nov 10).

Duke's big-cut-and-roll offense: 1.23 points per possession (97th percentile) through two games. Patrick Ngongba II had a career-high 28 and 9 vs Coastal Carolina. Helps Duke (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).

Duke beat Army and Coastal Carolina by a combined 95 points, forces 18.5 turnovers a game and shoots 34% from three. Soft opponents, but the turnover pressure matters against MSU. Helps Duke (Predictem, Nov 10).

[angle] Michigan State has to replace bigs Carson Cooper and Jaxon Kohler. Coen Carr and Anton Bonke are the options, and the Covers writer questions the rebuilt frontcourt against Duke's size, including 7-2 freshman Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje. Helps Duke (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).
MSU had 14 turnovers and 24 fouls vs Toledo and shoots 59.4% from the line, a problem in a close game against a team forcing 18.5 turnovers. Helps Duke (Predictem, Nov 10).
MSU averages 44.5 rebounds and allows 22.5, so its glass edge could keep it in the game. Helps MSU (Predictem, Nov 10).

Jeremy Fears Jr. (CBS preseason Player of the Year) has 20 assists in two games and controls the tempo. Both teams play at about 67 possessions, outside the top 240, and fewer possessions shrink a 7.5-point margin. Slightly helps MSU (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).
Barttorvik: Duke 1st, MSU 10th, both top-12 in adjusted offense and top-8 in adjusted defense. That is closer than 7.5 on a neutral floor. Helps MSU, but priced (Predictem, Nov 10).
Covers' model projects Duke -8 (writer on Duke -7.5); Predictem projects Duke 74-70 (writer on MSU +6.5). The two previews split, so no edge (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).
[angle] Duke won the last meeting 66-60 in East Lansing and the 2023 Champions Classic 74-65, taking four of the last five. Head-to-head history is a tiebreaker at most (Predictem, Nov 10).
Duke has won 23 of its last 25 games straight up. That is a moneyline trend, not ATS, and gives no spread read (Covers, Nov 10).
games.reasoning: The ratings say a 4-5 point game, but the market moved to Duke -7.5 and the matchup (MSU's rebuilt frontcourt, turnovers and poor free-throw shooting against Duke's pressure) explains why. The evidence splits and the two previews took opposite sides, so I pass. A confirmed MSU frontcourt absence would have made Duke a pick.

research: Line: slate Vanderbilt -16.5; archive close -13.5 (open -16.5). That is a 3-point gap between slate and close, which LESSONS treats as a data flag: don't build a case on either number. Predictem had 16.5 at most books and 15.5 at some on the morning (slate archive; Predictem, Nov 10).
Venue: Memorial Gymnasium in Nashville, a true home game for Vanderbilt (Predictem, Nov 10).

[angle] Memphis center Nemanja Popovic is serving a six-game NCAA withholding for past international play and has sat only two, so he is out again and Memphis is thin up front. Helps Vanderbilt, but known before the line (Predictem, Nov 10).
Memphis beat No. 18 Iowa State 80-76 in Sioux Falls and VCU 89-88 after trailing by 10 early in the second half. So it has shown it can stay with good teams. Helps Memphis (Predictem, Nov 10).

Jayden Reid scored 26 vs Iowa State and a career-high 32 vs VCU (11-of-21, 7 assists), and Rihards Vavers is 7-of-12 from three, so Memphis can score with this lineup. Helps Memphis (Predictem, Nov 10).
Memphis's defense let VCU make 13 of 24 threes; Barttorvik ranks Memphis's defense 161st and the team 102nd. Helps Vanderbilt (Predictem, Nov 10).
Vanderbilt beat Bellarmine 93-47 and Wake Forest 74-51, outrebounding Wake 48-33. Barttorvik has Vanderbilt 20th with the 11th-best defense. Helps Vanderbilt (Predictem, Nov 10).
Tyler Tanner averages 18.5 ppg and had a career-high 10 rebounds vs Wake. Helps Vanderbilt (Predictem, Nov 10).
[angle] Memphis went 2-11 ATS on the road last season. That is old ATS history from a different roster, so it doesn't count (Predictem, Nov 10).
Predictem projects Vanderbilt 85-73, a 12-13 point margin, and took Memphis +16.5. The close at 13.5 agrees with that, but preview picks are priced (Predictem, Nov 10).
Total rose from 158.5 to 161.5 at the close, so the market expects pace and scoring, which helps a dog that can score (slate archive).
games.reasoning: The close (13.5) suggests the market came down to roughly the preview's 12-13 point projection, which would make Memphis +16.5 a value number. But LESSONS flags a 3-point slate-vs-close gap as a data issue and says slate-number edges haven't paid. I pass, with Memphis as the forced side because it has shown it can score against good teams. A clean slate-equals-close line would have left no read.

research: Venue: United Supermarkets Arena, Lubbock, a true road game for Illinois (Predictem, Nov 10).
Line: slate Illinois -2.5; archive open TT +1.5, close +2.5. A small move toward Illinois; slate equals close (slate archive).

[angle] Texas Tech star JT Toppin is out with a torn ACL; he scored 35 against Illinois last November. Transfer forward Jamichael Stillwell is expected to debut. Helps Illinois, but priced (Predictem, Nov 10).
Illinois is missing David Mirkovic (multiple surgeries) and Jake Davis (shoulder). Helps TT, also priced (Predictem, Nov 10).

[angle] TT's shooters are cold: Darrion Williams (back from NC State) is 2-of-10 for 7 points, and Donovan Atwell is 3-of-16 from three after 45.8% last season. Dra Gibbs-Lawhorn (25 vs Bethune-Cookman) is carrying the offense. Mixed: helps Illinois now, but these are candidates to bounce back (Predictem, Nov 10).

Illinois: Andrej Stojakovic averages 22.5 ppg and freshman Quentin Coleman is hot. Illinois scored 120 vs FDU and 112 vs Penn, an average margin of 58.5. Helps Illinois, but against weak opponents (Predictem, Nov 10).
Texas Tech beat Jackson State 76-42 and Bethune-Cookman 76-58 and is allowing about 50 points a game. Helps TT's defensive case (Predictem, Nov 10).
[angle] Size mismatch: Illinois is 10th-tallest in KenPom's average height, TT 303rd, and Illinois has a +36.5 rebound margin. Helps Illinois (Predictem, Nov 10).
Tempo: TT about 315th, Illinois 41st. A slow home game shrinks the margin, which helps TT +2.5 slightly (Predictem, Nov 10).
The total rose from about 160.5 to 167.5 with money on the Over. That is a market note, not a side (Predictem, Nov 10).
Predictem projects Illinois 81-76, a 5-point road win, against a 2.5-point line (Predictem, Nov 10).
games.reasoning: Illinois's size and rebounding against a short TT team without Toppin is the clearest matchup edge, but both sides are missing key players and the line has already moved a point toward Illinois. My projection of Illinois by 3.5 is within a point of the number, so I pass. A confirmed return for either side's injured player would have moved it.

research: Line: slate Virginia -37.5; archive close -38.5 (open -37.5). The close moved a point toward Virginia (slate archive).
Virginia is 3-0 and No. 6, and beat No. 12 Arkansas 91-72 in D.C. with a 27-point second-half lead and all five starters in double figures. Helps Virginia (Predictem, Nov 10).
Barttorvik ranks Virginia 4th, with a top-3 offense and top-10 defense; four starters return from a 30-6 team. Helps Virginia (Predictem, Nov 10).
Bucknell is 0-2 and Barttorvik 355th, with offense and defense both near the bottom of Division I. Helps Virginia (Predictem, Nov 10).
Bucknell lost by 29 at Maryland and 82-62 to Old Dominion; ODU made 17-of-31 threes and outrebounded Bucknell 37-20. Helps Virginia (Predictem, Nov 10).
[angle] Virginia is playing its second game in three days after the Arkansas game. That raises the chance of a lighter rotation and resting starters. Helps Bucknell (Predictem, Nov 10).

[angle] The writer expects Thijs De Ridder (ACC Preseason POY), Johann Grunloh and Chance Mallory to rest if the margin gets big, which is the backdoor case for Bucknell. Priced in large spreads per LESSONS (Predictem, Nov 10).
Bench depth: Kalu Anya and Elijah Gertrude played well off the bench vs Arkansas, so Virginia's reserves can keep extending the lead. Helps Virginia (Predictem, Nov 10).
Bucknell made 7-of-24 threes vs ODU, so its offense hasn't shown it can score enough to keep a big dog's backdoor open. Helps Virginia (Predictem, Nov 10).
[angle] The last meeting, in December 2000, was Virginia 99-49. Ancient history; no weight (Predictem, Nov 10).
Predictem projects Virginia 91-58 (33) and took Bucknell +37.5 as a small edge. Preview picks and ratings are priced (Predictem, Nov 10).
games.reasoning: This is a 25+ point college spread, which LESSONS says gives no edge either way. Bench-rest arguments are priced, and Bucknell's offense hasn't shown it can score. I pass. The forced side is Virginia, because the close moved a point past the slate and Bucknell's offense is weak; an injury in Virginia's rotation would have flipped it.

research: Line: slate Arizona -36.5; archive close -35.5 (open -36.5). The close moved a point toward NAU (slate archive).
Arizona is 1-1: it lost 84-75 to UCLA in Las Vegas, then beat Cal Poly 104-84 (56-26 in the paint, 14 steals). Mixed (Predictem, Nov 10).
Arizona is 11-of-44 from three this season, and poor shooting makes it harder to pull away to 36+. Helps NAU (Predictem, Nov 10).
Under Tommy Lloyd, Arizona is 77-7 at home and wins by 22.0 points a game, well short of 36.5 on average. Context helps NAU, but the opponents vary (Predictem, Nov 10).
Ivan Kharchenkov averages 27 ppg and leads KenPom's early POY race, and Motiejus Krivas scored 30 vs Cal Poly. Helps Arizona (Predictem, Nov 10).
[angle] Clemson transfer RJ Godfrey has a court hearing Tuesday that could clear him to play. His availability is unresolved, so it doesn't decide anything (Predictem, Nov 10).
[angle] Arizona plays at Auburn on Friday. The look-ahead and starters easing off once the game is decided help NAU, but that is a priced narrative (Predictem, Nov 10).
NAU is 0-2 and KenPom about 296th. It led UNLV by 12 in the first half before losing 89-77, then lost by 29 at New Mexico. Mixed (Predictem, Nov 10).
NAU turned it over 18 times at UNLV and 16 at New Mexico, which feeds Arizona's transition game (14 steals vs Cal Poly). Helps Arizona (Predictem, Nov 10).
NAU sophomore Chris Komin scored 24 and 21, so NAU has a scorer who can add late points. Helps NAU (Predictem, Nov 10).
Predictem projects Arizona 91-60 (31) and leans NAU +36.5, not below +35. Priced (Predictem, Nov 10).
games.reasoning: Another 25+ spread with no edge per LESSONS. Arizona's cold three-point shooting and the Auburn look-ahead argue for NAU, and NAU's turnovers argue for Arizona. The close moved a point toward NAU, so the forced side is NAU. Godfrey's clearance is the unresolved status that would have changed it.

research: Line: slate BYU -28.5; archive open -27.5, close -28.5. Predictem says it was about -25.5 earlier in the week, a 3-point move toward BYU. Slate equals close (slate archive; Predictem, Nov 10).
Venue: Marriott Center, Provo. BYU's non-conference home win streak is 27 games. Helps BYU (Predictem, Nov 10).
Robert Wright III averages 27 ppg (career-high 35 vs Ohio State), and Syracuse transfer Tyler Betsey is 10-of-14 from three. Helps BYU (Predictem, Nov 10).
BYU beat Omaha 108-something and won fast-break points 31-0. Against a Queens team that pushes the pace, that is a lot of transition scoring. Helps BYU (Predictem, Nov 10).

[angle] BYU's coach Kevin Young wants more bench production: 11 players logged double-digit minutes vs Omaha, with 25 bench points. Heavy bench use late helps Queens' backdoor chances (Predictem, Nov 10).
Queens lost 118-68 at Oklahoma State with 18 turnovers. Helps BYU (Predictem, Nov 10).
Queens scored 103 vs Winthrop and 96 at LMU, and Nasir Mann (19.3 ppg, ASUN Player of the Week after 28 at LMU) can score. A big dog needs offense, so this helps Queens (Predictem, Nov 10).
[angle] Queens is on a road trip through four time zones in four games, so fatigue could set in at altitude in Provo. Helps BYU (Predictem, Nov 10).
Torvik: BYU about 120 points per 100 possessions on offense; Queens' defense ranks 320th. KenPom projects BYU 100-76 (24). Priced (Predictem, Nov 10).
BYU is 8-0 under Young when it makes 15+ threes. A conditional trend, not predictive (Predictem, Nov 10).
Total 181.5: a very fast game with lots of possessions widens the range of margins. No side (slate archive).
games.reasoning: This is a 25+ spread, and the market moved 3 points toward BYU during the week despite KenPom's ~24. Queens' travel fatigue and the 18 turnovers at Oklahoma State point to BYU, while BYU's bench use and Queens' ability to score point to a backdoor. The evidence is balanced, so I pass, with BYU as the forced side after the week's move. A BYU injury would have pushed it to Queens.

research: Neutral site: Champions Classic at the United Center, Chicago; Kentucky is the designated home team (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).

Line: slate Kansas -4.5; archive open and close Kentucky +5.5. CBS quoted Kentucky +5.5 on game day. The close is a point better for Kansas than the slate, which slightly favors Kansas -4.5 (slate archive; Predictem, Nov 10).

[angle] Kansas guard Melvin Council Jr. broke a bone in his foot in practice, will have surgery and is out until about January. The line still sat at Kansas -5.5 at the close, so the market priced him out and still backed Kansas. Helps Kentucky in theory, but priced (Predictem, Nov 10).

Without Council, Kansas is expected to go bigger, with Keanu Dawes or Christian Reeves alongside Tyran Stokes and Trey Kaufman-Renn. Kaufman-Renn was a late roster addition, and the full team has practiced together only about three weeks. Lineup uncertainty helps Kentucky (Predictem, Nov 10).
Kansas held Fordham and Middle Tennessee to 28.5% shooting, and Torvik rates Kansas a top-5 defense. Helps Kansas (Predictem, Nov 10).
Kentucky ranks 319th in getting to the free-throw line; Kansas ranks 9th in free-throw rate defense. Helps Kansas (Covers, Nov 10).
Kansas shoots 53.8% from the line, 345th nationally, which can cost it a lead late. Helps Kentucky (Covers, Nov 10).
Haslametrics: Kansas's strength of schedule is about 100 spots better. Kansas also played Pitt State, Louisville and Duke in October. Helps Kansas (Covers, Nov 10).
[angle] Kentucky's Milan Momcilovic, called the best shooter in the sport, is the main risk to a Kansas cover. Helps Kentucky (Predictem, Nov 10).

[angle] Off the court: Bill Self considered retiring this offseason and came back, while Mark Pope faces growing pressure after several close wins. Kentucky is 29-26 vs high-major teams under Pope. Narrative only (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).
Kansas is 4-0-1 ATS in its last five neutral-site games as a favorite. Team ATS trends are priced (Covers, Nov 10).
Predictem projects Kansas 77-73 (4); the Covers writer took Kansas -4.5, playable to -6.5. The previews are split near the number (Covers and Predictem, Nov 10).
games.reasoning: Kansas has the better defense and schedule, and the market held it at -5.5 even after the Council injury. But Kansas's free-throw shooting, a new lineup and Momcilovic keep this near the number. My projection of Kansas by 5 is within a point of 4.5, so I pass, with Kansas as the forced side because the close is a point better. Clearer word on Kansas's rotation without Council would have moved it.
